question: Unsere Tochter kam zur Welt, bevor wir geheiratet haben. Mein Mann hat schon vor der Hochzeit offiziell erklärt, dass er der Vater ist, danach haben wir geheiratet. Wird sie jetzt rechtlich wie ein in der Ehe geborenes Kind behandelt, und wer könnte die Vatererklärung meines Mannes später noch angreifen?

gold_facts.text: When the parents marry, the rules for a child born during the marriage apply by analogy to a child born before the marriage, once the husband's paternity is established by recognition or by judgment.
The recognition can be challenged by the mother, by the husband, and by the husband's commune of origin or domicile.

The child (or after its death its descendants) can challenge the recognition if the spouses' life together ended while the child was a minor or if the recognition took place after the child turned 12.

competing_candidates: The general rule on challenging a recognition of paternity (any interested person may challenge) also bears on who can contest; the question is narrowed to parents who married after the recognition.

question: Mon père me propose de renoncer dès maintenant à ma part de sa succession en échange d'une somme d'argent versée tout de suite. Si j'accepte et qu'il décède plus tard, est-ce que mes propres enfants pourront hériter à ma place ?

gold_facts.text: The deceased can conclude with an heir a contract by which the heir waives the inheritance, with or without consideration.
The person who waived is not considered an heir when the succession opens.
Unless the contract provides otherwise, the waiver also has effect against the descendants of the person who waived.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring rules on a waiver made in favour of specific co-heirs and on the rights of the waiving heir's creditors touch the same contract but not the effect on descendants.

question: I found a lost dog wandering around inside a busy public train station building. I don't know who it belongs to. What am I legally required to do with it, and who do I hand it over or report it to?

gold_facts.text: A person who finds a lost animal must notify the owner and, if the owner is unknown, report the find.
The cantons designate the office to which the find of an animal must be reported.

The duty to notify and report for animals is subject to the rule that a person who finds something in an inhabited house or in a facility serving public use or traffic must hand it over to the master of the house, the tenant or the persons in charge of supervision.

competing_candidates: Later rules on finders (keeping the find, reward, acquisition of ownership after a waiting period) address what happens afterwards, not the initial duties.
note: A expressly reserves the hand-over rule for finds in houses or public facilities from B; the station setting makes both needed.

question: How does Swiss law work out how closely two family members are related? For example, why is my grandmother related to me in a different way than my cousin is?

gold_facts.text: The degree of kinship is determined by the number of births that link the two persons.
Two persons are related in the direct line if one descends from the other.
Two persons are related in the collateral line if they descend from a common third person and are not related to each other in the direct line.

competing_candidates: The rule on relationship by marriage (in-laws) is a neighbouring definition but does not answer blood relationship.

question: J'ai un droit de passage inscrit sur le terrain de mon voisin et je l'utilise toujours. Il veut le faire rayer ou modifier au registre foncier. Peut-il le faire sans moi, ou faut-il mon accord, et sous quelle forme ?

gold_facts.text: Deleting or modifying an entry in the land register requires a written declaration by the persons entitled under that entry.
This declaration can be given by signing the daybook (journal) of the land register.

competing_candidates: Rules on simplified deletion of entries that have obviously lost their legal significance, and on judicial deletion of an easement that has lost its usefulness, could also bear on removal; the question states the right is still used.

question: I lent a friend money and he offered his motorbike as security, but he wants to keep riding it himself until he pays me back. Can I get a valid security right over the bike while it stays with him?

gold_facts.text: Except where the law provides otherwise, movable things can be pledged only by transferring possession to the creditor.
No pledge right exists as long as the pledgor retains exclusive actual control of the thing.

competing_candidates: The statutory exception for pledging livestock without transfer of possession is a different rule; a motorbike does not fall under it.

question: Dans notre immeuble en propriété par étages, un propriétaire ne paie plus ses charges communes depuis plusieurs années. La communauté peut-elle obtenir une garantie inscrite directement sur son lot, pour quels arriérés, et qui peut demander cette inscription ?

gold_facts.text: To secure its claims for contributions of the last three years, the community of owners is entitled to have a legal mortgage established on the share of each co-owner.

Registration can be requested by the administrator or, if there is none, by any co-owner authorised by a majority decision of the co-owners or by the court, and by a creditor in whose favour the contribution claim was seized.
Otherwise the rules on establishing the legal mortgage of craftsmen and contractors apply by analogy.

competing_candidates: The community's retention right over movables in the unit secures the same contributions; the question is narrowed to a security on the unit share itself.

question: Il mio vicino ha costruito anni fa un edificio alto che toglie luce e sole alla mia casa. A suo tempo ha rispettato tutte le norme edilizie in vigore. Posso comunque fargli causa per questa perdita, e in quali casi invece potrei agire?

gold_facts.text: A person who suffers or is threatened with harm because a landowner exceeds his property right can sue the owner to restore the previous state or to take measures against the danger, in addition to damages.
If a building or installation deprives the neighbouring property of certain qualities, the owner can be sued only if the building rules in force when it was built were not respected.

competing_candidates: The rule defining excessive emissions between neighbours describes the duty but not this limitation for buildings; planting distance or excavation rules are different topics.

question: Ich habe ein im Grundbuch vorgemerktes Vorkaufsrecht am Nachbargrundstück. Der Eigentümer verkauft es nun an jemand anderen, ohne mir etwas zu sagen. Muss mich das Grundbuchamt von sich aus darüber informieren, und ab wann läuft für mich die Frist, um die Eintragung anzufechten?

gold_facts.text: The land registrar must notify interested persons of entries made without their knowledge.
In particular, the registrar notifies the acquisition of ownership by a third party to the holders of a pre-emption right that is noted in the land register or given by law and shown in the register.
The time limits for contesting such entries start to run from the notification.

competing_candidates: The seller's own duty to inform the pre-emption holder and the time limit for exercising the pre-emption right (in the Code of Obligations and in the Civil Code rules on statutory pre-emption) concern the same sale; the question is narrowed to the registrar's duty and the time limit for contesting the entry.

question: Years ago my neighbour built a balcony that hangs over our garden, without any agreement with us. We saw it being built and never complained. Now we want it gone. Could a court instead let him keep it, and on what terms?

gold_facts.text: Buildings and other structures projecting from one property over another remain part of the property they project from if their owner has a real right to their existence; this right can be registered as an easement.

If the projecting structure was built without a right but the injured neighbour did not object in time although it was recognisable, the court may, where the circumstances justify it, grant the builder acting in good faith the real right to the structure or ownership of the land.
Such a grant by the court is made against fair compensation.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring rules on building on another person's land with one's own materials (allocation of land ownership) are similar but concern construction on, not projecting over, the land.

question: Die Behörde hat für das Vermögen meines minderjährigen Neffen einen Beistand eingesetzt, weil seine Eltern das Geld des Kindes zu verschleudern drohten. Wird darüber das Betreibungsamt informiert, und unter welchen Voraussetzungen setzt die Behörde überhaupt einen solchen Verwalter für das Kindesvermögen ein?

gold_facts.text: When it orders a measure, the adult protection authority immediately notifies the debt enforcement office at the person's domicile, once the decision is enforceable, of any placement of a minor under guardianship or under the curatorship for the administration of the child's property.
If there is no other way to prevent the child's property from being endangered, the child protection authority entrusts its administration to a curator.
The child protection authority can also entrust administration to a curator if it is feared that the income of the child's property or amounts taken from it will not be used as the law requires.

competing_candidates: General rules on child protection measures and on the parents' use of the child's property are neighbours of B but do not provide the curator for administration.

question: Ma mère, atteinte de démence, est sous curatelle. Son curateur veut vendre sa maison et mettre fin au bail de l'appartement où elle vit. Peut-il le faire de sa propre initiative, ou doit-il obtenir une autorisation, et de qui ?

gold_facts.text: The consent of the adult protection authority is required when the curator, acting as the person's representative, sells or pledges land.
The consent of the adult protection authority is also required when the curator terminates the contract for premises in which the person lives or liquidates the household.
Consent is not required if the person, being capable of judgement, agrees and her capacity to act is not restricted by the curatorship.

competing_candidates: The rule allowing the authority to make further transactions subject to its consent for specific reasons is a neighbour but does not list these acts.

question: Sulla mia casa c'è un'ipoteca registrata al secondo posto, ma al primo posto non c'è nessun debito reale: non è mai stata costituita alcuna ipoteca prima. Se la casa viene venduta all'asta, come si divide il ricavato tra i creditori? Il posto vuoto viene tenuto da parte?

gold_facts.text: If a mortgage was created in a later rank without a prior one existing, or the debtor has not disposed of a prior mortgage certificate, or the prior claim is smaller than registered, the empty ranks are disregarded in the realisation.
In the realisation of the pledge the proceeds are allocated to the actual mortgage creditors according to their rank.

competing_candidates: The rule on fixed ranks and empty pledge positions (no automatic advancement of later creditors) concerns ranking outside realisation and could be retrieved instead; the question is narrowed to the forced sale.

question: My fiancée and I called off our engagement. I had already paid deposits for the wedding venue and the caterer. Can I ask her to share those costs?

gold_facts.text: If one of the engaged persons made arrangements in good faith with a view to the marriage, they can claim an appropriate contribution from the other when the engagement is dissolved.
The claim exists only where it does not appear inequitable in view of all the circumstances.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring rules on returning engagement gifts and on the time limit for engagement claims cover related topics but not the cost contribution.

question: Le curateur de mon oncle a signé pour lui un contrat important sans demander l'accord de l'autorité qui le surveille, alors que cet accord était obligatoire. Quelles conséquences ce contrat a-t-il pour mon oncle : est-il traité autrement que si une personne protégée avait signé elle-même sans l'accord de son représentant ?

gold_facts.text: A legal act done without the required consent of the adult protection authority has, for the person concerned, only the effects that the law of persons provides when the consent of the legal representative is missing.

competing_candidates: The law-of-persons rules on acts done without the legal representative's consent (restitution, liability) give the detailed effects to which A refers.
note: Same-language control item; question avoids the article's terms where possible.

question: Someone knowingly kept my car for months after I asked for it back, and even rented it out to other people. Now he finally has to return it. What does he owe me besides the car, and can he charge me for the money he spent on it?

gold_facts.text: A possessor in bad faith must return the thing and compensate the entitled person for all damage caused by the wrongful withholding, and for the fruits he collected or failed to collect.
A possessor in bad faith has a claim for his expenses only if the entitled person would also have had to incur them.

competing_candidates: The rules on the good-faith possessor (no liability, compensation of expenses) are the counterpart and could be retrieved; the question states the possessor knew.

question: Ein Gericht hat bei unserer Trennung festgelegt, bei wem die Kinder leben und wie sie geschützt werden. Wer darf diese Regelung später ändern: nur das Gericht, oder auch die Kindesschutzbehörde? Hängt das davon ab, ob gerade ein Scheidungsverfahren läuft?

gold_facts.text: The court is competent to modify court-ordered measures on the allocation and protection of children in divorce proceedings, in proceedings to modify the divorce judgment, and in proceedings to modify measures protecting the marital union.
In all other cases the child protection authority is competent.

competing_candidates: The divorce rule on new arrangements after a change of circumstances (child protection authority competent where the parents agree) and the rule on the court's competence to order child protection measures in marital proceedings both bear on competence; the question stays general about modifying court-ordered child measures.

question: Nous divorçons et nos enfants vivront chez leur mère. Qu'est-ce que le juge doit régler au sujet des enfants dans le divorce, et est-ce que j'aurai le droit de continuer à les voir même si je ne les ai pas chez moi ?

gold_facts.text: The divorce court regulates the parents' rights and duties under the rules on the effects of parentage, in particular parental authority, custody, personal contact or each parent's share in care, and maintenance.
The court takes into account all circumstances important for the child's welfare, the parents' joint request and, as far as possible, the child's opinion.
A parent who does not hold parental authority or custody and the minor child have a mutual right to the personal contact appropriate to the circumstances.
A parent can demand that his or her right to personal contact be regulated.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring rules on limits and refusal of personal contact and on information rights of the non-custodial parent touch the same topic.

question: Ho scoperto che mio marito, quando ci siamo sposati, era ancora sposato con un'altra donna all'estero e quel primo matrimonio non era mai stato sciolto. Il nostro matrimonio è comunque valido?

gold_facts.text: A marriage is declared invalid if, at the time it was concluded, one spouse was already married or in a registered partnership with a third person and that earlier marriage or partnership had not been dissolved.

competing_candidates: The rules on who may bring the invalidity action and on the effects of a judgment of invalidity are neighbours; the impediment of an existing marriage also appears among the conditions for marrying.

question: My father died and his will leaves as much as possible to my stepmother. To work out how much of his estate he was free to give away, at what point in time are his assets valued, and what gets subtracted first?

gold_facts.text: The freely disposable portion is calculated on the state of the estate at the time of death.
The deceased's debts, funeral costs, costs of sealing and of the inventory are deducted.
The cost of maintaining for one month the persons who lived with the deceased is also deducted.

competing_candidates: The rule adding certain lifetime gifts to the estate for the calculation, and the forced-share percentages, are related but separate parts of the calculation.

question: Je vais prendre une voiture en leasing auprès d'un garage. Le contrat doit-il être écrit, et quelles informations doit-il obligatoirement contenir, notamment sur ce que je devrai payer si j'arrête le leasing avant la fin ?

gold_facts.text: Consumer leasing contracts must be concluded in writing, and the lessee receives a copy.

The contract must state, among other things, a description of the leased item and its cash price, the number, amount and due dates of the instalments, any deposit, and the effective annual interest rate.
The contract must include a table showing what the lessee must pay, in addition to instalments already paid, if the lease ends early, and the residual value of the item at that time.

competing_candidates: The rule on the lessee's right to terminate a leasing contract early, and the general contract-content rule for cash credits, are nearby in the same act; the question asks about form and contents of a leasing contract.

question: Une plateforme en ligne organise pour moi un prêt pour acheter une moto, financé ensemble par plusieurs particuliers qui ne prêtent pas à titre professionnel. Comment la loi sur le crédit aux consommateurs qualifie-t-elle cette plateforme, et en quoi est-ce différent d'un simple courtier en crédit ?

gold_facts.text: A credit intermediary is any natural or legal person who professionally brokers consumer credit contracts.

A crowdlending intermediary is any natural or legal person who professionally organises, for individual consumers, a coordinated granting of consumer credit in which several lenders not acting professionally can take part.

competing_candidates: The definition of the lender and of the consumer credit contract are neighbouring definitions in the same act.

question: Ich kaufe im Möbelhaus ein Sofa und bezahle es über einen Kredit in Raten ab. Was muss in so einem Kreditvertrag zusätzlich drinstehen, zum Beispiel wem das Sofa gehört, solange ich es nicht fertig abbezahlt habe?

gold_facts.text: A credit contract financing goods or services must additionally contain a description of the goods or services and both the cash price and the price payable under the credit contract.
It must state any down payment and the number, amount and due dates of the instalments, or the method for determining them if still unknown when the contract is concluded.
If ownership does not pass to the consumer immediately, it must name the owner of the goods and the conditions under which the consumer becomes owner.

competing_candidates: The general list of mandatory contents for any consumer credit contract applies as well and could be retrieved; the question asks what must be stated in addition for a purchase financed by credit.
